faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Jamshedpur JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Jamshedpur is September 16, 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech. and M. Tech. or equivalent degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field, with a First Class or 60% marks.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the JRF position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at NIT Jamshedpur.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The salary for the JRF position ranges from Rs. 37,000 to Rs. 42,000 per month, plus HRA, depending on the year of service.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates are required to apply by sending their application via Email.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the NIT Jamshedpur JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the JRF position will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is NIT JSR/DEE/202/2026.

faq.question: Q9. Which department is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Department of Electrical Engineering (DEE) at NIT Jamshedpur.

faq.question: Q10. Where is NIT Jamshedpur located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Jamshedpur is located in Jamshedpur, Jharkhand, with the pincode 831014.
